messages:
maya: Can we lock down GPU quota/reservation for the eu-west3 cluster bring-up? Need A100 80GB x16 reserved for a 2-week boot window starting 2026-04-05. Who can own the quota request?

josh: I can start the GCP quota ticket. Need exact project ID and preferred SKU string to avoid back-and-forth. Also confirm whether you want a regional quota bump or a capacity reservation / commitment.

maya: Project is rw-infer-prod-eu. SKU to reference: "NVIDIA_A100_80GB" (GCE accelerator SKU). We want a regional quota bump plus a short-term reservation to guarantee nodes during bring-up. Start date 2026-04-05, duration 14 days.

priya: For GCP, we'll submit two things: 1) Quota increase for accelerators in eu-west3, 2) a Capacity Reservation for the target instance family (n1-standard / custom + GPUs) so autoscaler can't steal them. I'll draft the request.

carlos: FYI we should include these in the billing alerts and tag resources with cost_center:infra/bringup and cluster:eu-west3-beta so finance can track. Cost estimate: ~€12k/day at peak for A100 x16 nodes — flagging for approval.

josh: Drafting ticket now. Copying the gcloud check command I used locally to confirm current quotas:```bash
gcloud compute regions describe eu-west3 --project=rw-infer-prod-eu --format="json(quotas)" | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric | test("GPUS"))'
```This helps the cloud team see current usage vs requested.

ops-runbooks: Quick checklist for bring-up reservation + validation (short version):
- Submit quota increase ticket to cloud console (include SKU, project, start/end dates)
- Create Capacity Reservation for the planned instance config
- Reserve static IP ranges + subnets for cluster nodes (avoid overlay conflicts)
- Create firewall rules and validate peering to prod VPC
- Tag reservations with cost_center and runbook:eu-west3-bringup
- Smoke test VM boots and driver install (NVIDIA driver + CUDA)
- Run perf harness (1k tokens/sec target mem profile) and confirm latency budget
- Handoff to oncall for live validation

leah: I can take validation on day0. I'll need a short runbook for the smoke tests and the perf harness command. Can someone paste the minimal test steps here so I can run them on day0?

priya: Minimal smoke steps:```bash
# 1) boot one reserved instance
gcloud compute instances create smoke-eu1 --machine-type=n1-standard-16 --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1 --zone=eu-west3-b --reservation-affinity=any --project=rw-infer-prod-eu
# 2) verify driver
ssh smoke-eu1 -- 'nvidia-smi'
# 3) run small perf harness (container)
docker run --rm ghcr.io/redwood-inference/perf-harness:latest --model=gpt-small --tokens=1000 --concurrency=8
```That should cover basic health + perf.

ben: Filed ticket INFRA-412 and created the Capacity Reservation CR-2026-04-EUW. Ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-412 (added SKU and timing). infra-bot will post updates.

infra-bot: quota-request-412 created (GCP case #123456789). Status: pending review by Google. Assigned to cloud-ops. Estimated review time ~48-72h.

deploy-bot: reservation CR-2026-04-EUW created in project rw-infer-prod-eu, reservation id: res-euw-20260405, capacity: A100_80GB x16, zones: eu-west3-b,c. Tagging: cluster:eu-west3-bringup, cost_center:infra/bringup.

maya: Thanks all. Priya, please paste the exact quota ask text you submit so I can route to finance for cost pre-approval. Also make sure to ask for an emergency fallback plan (we need a swap to nearby region if GCP can't approve in time).

priya: Quota ask snippet I used in the ticket: "Requesting temporary regional accelerator quota increase in eu-west3: +16 A100 80GB (total requested=32) for project rw-infer-prod-eu. Purpose: cluster bring-up and validation window 2026-04-05 to 2026-04-19. Also request capacity reservation for 16 A100s across zones b,c for the same window. Please prioritize for business-critical deployment. Contact: priya@redwood.ai, +1-555-0102."

carlos: I'll ping finance now with the ticket and the cost estimate. If they sign off, we can approve the chargeback tag and proceed.

leah: I'll be on standby 2026-04-05 08:00 UTC for the validation window. Please assign me the runbook link and the perf harness image.

ben: Noted. Added runbook link to INFRA-412 and attached perf container. Once GCP confirms, I'll switch reservation from tentative to confirmed and leave notes on the ticket.

maya: Great. If GCP denies or delays, fallback plan: try one of two options — (1) split reservation across eu-west1 + eu-west3 with cross-region routing, or (2) borrow from Dedicated pool for 72h. Carlos, can you check feasibility for (2)?

carlos: I'll check Dedicated pool availability and post back by EOD today.

infra-bot: quota-request-412 status update: under review -> awaiting clarifying info. Comment requested: please specify whether GPUs will be used with sole-tenant nodes or preemptible instances.

josh: Replying on the case: will use regular instances with Capacity Reservation (non-preemptible). Submitted additional comment.

maya: Thanks. We'll reconvene here once cloud confirms. :thumbsup:
